easy.def: A time when you rest and do not go to school or work.
examples: We went to the beach on vacation.
No school! It is summer vacation.
We took a vacation to see Grandma.

more.def: A time of rest away from school or work, often spent on a trip.
examples: Our family spent summer vacation camping in the mountains.
He sent a postcard while on vacation in Italy.
The store owner is taking a week of vacation.
The gold ring is valuable.
Clean water is valuable.
This old coin is valuable.

more.def: Worth a lot of money, or very important and useful.
examples: Her advice was valuable because it helped me solve the problem.
A good friend is more valuable than gold.
The painting is too valuable to hang in the hallway.

easy.def: To go away so no one can see it.
examples: The magician made the coin vanish.
The fog will vanish soon.
My cookie vanished!
The deer vanished into the forest before I could take a picture.
The rainbow vanished when the sun went behind a cloud.
Her smile vanished when she heard the news.
The shop sells various toys.
We saw various bugs in the yard.
The crayons come in various colors.
The garden has flowers of various colors and sizes.
People came to the fair from various towns.
There are various ways to solve this problem.

easy.def: A thing that takes people from place to place, like a car or bus.
examples: A truck is a big vehicle.
A bus is a vehicle for many people.
The vehicle has four wheels.

more.def: A machine such as a car, bus, or truck that carries people or things.
examples: Only emergency vehicles may park in front of the hospital.
A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels.
The road was closed to all vehicles during the parade.
Our team cheered after the victory.
We won! It is a victory!
The victory made us happy.

more.def: The act of winning a game, contest, or battle.
examples: The team's victory was their first of the season.
The crowd cheered the runner's victory.
It was a narrow victory, won by a single point.
My grandma lives in a village.
The village has one little shop.
We walked to the village.

more.def: A small group of houses and buildings, smaller than a town.
examples: The village had one school, one shop, and a tiny post office.
Fishing boats lined the shore of the village.
Everyone in the village knows each other.

easy.def: A person who comes to see you or a place.
examples: We have a visitor at our house.
The visitor rang the bell.
Our class had a visitor today.

more.def: A person who goes to see someone or to spend time in a place.
examples: Visitors to the park must stay on the trails.
The new baby had many visitors at the hospital.
A visitor from Japan spoke to our class.

easy.def: A mountain that can shoot out hot melted rock.
examples: The volcano had smoke on top.
Hot lava came out of the volcano.
The island has a volcano.

more.def: A mountain with an opening where melted rock, ash, and gas can burst out.
examples: When the volcano erupted, lava flowed down its sides.
The island was formed by a volcano long ago.
Ash from the volcano covered the nearby town.

easy.def: A long trip on a ship or in space.
examples: The ship went on a long voyage.
We read about a voyage to the moon.
The voyage took many days.

more.def: A long journey, especially by sea or through space.
examples: The voyage across the ocean took three weeks.
The explorers set off on a voyage around the world.
The spacecraft began its long voyage to Mars.
